title: AgentGov external evidence document
description: Evidence produced outside the static scanner: test results, runtime records, external attestations, and manual reviews. The scanner validates each item, checks its binding to the repository content, and checks its signature when one is present. An item is credited only when it is valid. Static and configuration evidence can only come from the scanner itself and is rejected here.

agent_id.description: Agent identifier, or * for every agent in the repository.

commit_sha.description: Binds the item to one commit.

subject.description: Binds the item to exact file content. The digest is SHA-256 over, for each path in sorted order: the path, a NUL byte, the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the file content with CRLF normalized to LF, and a newline.

identity_context.description: Non-sensitive reference to who or what produced the item.

signature.description: Base64 (standard encoding) Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON form of the item.
